text: There was blood beneath her rug. Baines heard the disturbance. Tell us what happened when Nora wouldn’t listen.
direction: Inspector Ellis, a tall middle-aged London detective. Clear dry precise voice, educated southern English accent, quietly persistent. Lighter upper baritone with a dry, clean edge, crisp consonants and slightly quicker connected phrasing. Understate questions with a small questioning lift. Never adopt Reed’s bass weight.
